---
title: "Global Gender Inequality Index: Change 2010–2019"
author: "TengDe Wang"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(countrycode)
```

## 1. Read in data
```{r read, message=FALSE}
# UNDP composite indices (1990–2023)
gii <- read_csv(here("data", "HDR25_Composite_indices_complete_time_series.csv"),
                locale = locale(encoding = "latin1"),
                na = c("", "NA", "..")) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  select(iso3, country, gii_2010, gii_2019) %>%
  mutate(gii_diff_2010_2019 = gii_2019 - gii_2010)

# World countries
world <- st_read(here("data", "World_Countries_(Generalized)_2173680399808997149.geojson"),
                 quiet = TRUE) %>%
  clean_names()

names(world)
```
## 2. Join
```{r join, warning=FALSE}
world_gii <- world %>%
  mutate(iso3 = countrycode(iso, origin = "iso2c", destination = "iso3c")) %>%
  left_join(gii, by = "iso3")

world_gii %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(country.x, iso3, gii_2010, gii_2019, gii_diff_2010_2019) %>%
  head(10)
```

## 3. Map the change

Negative values = inequality decreased between 2010 and 2019.

```{r map}
ggplot(world_gii) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = gii_diff_2010_2019), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166ac", mid = "#f7f7f7", high = "#b2182b",
                       midpoint = 0, na.value = "grey80",
                       name = "GII change\n(2019 − 2010)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Change in Gender Inequality Index, 2010–2019",
       caption = "Data: UNDP HDR; ArcGIS Hub World Countries (Generalized)")
```

## 4. Save output

```{r save}
st_write(world_gii, here("world_gii.geojson"), delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
```
